tagline: Jev balances a rod on a moving cart, live

examples.prompt: Set Jev Pendulum up as a tense balancing rig — a stiff rod under gravity 8 with a gust every few ticks that shoves it toward the fall line. Give Jev a style line for how to recover, then watch it hold, wobble, and eventually drop.
examples.caption: Jev's Balancing Act — a fast decision model keeping a rod upright, and losing it at high gravity
